compress_wikidata_json_to_jsonl: run the compress step to convert wikidata-all.json into a filtered compressed JSONL file
normalize_wikidata_with_mgenre: run the normalize step to tokenize and detokenize all sitelinks, labels, descriptions, and aliases using mGENRE
build_wikidata_lookup_dicts: run the dicts step to build and pickle lookup dictionaries mapping language titles, labels, and aliases to Wikidata IDs
process_wikipedia_redirects: run the redirects step to parse Wikipedia redirect files and build a language-specific redirect-to-title mapping
extract_freebase_id_mappings: run the freebase step to extract and save bidirectional mappings between Wikidata IDs and Freebase IDs
